definition.common_support_estimand: repeat each family-specific grid on the 64 questions contributing mismatch records for all three families
definition.comparison_grid: all ten unordered executor pairs at each cutoff in {1,5,20}
definition.equal_model_estimand: average the three family-specific P or H rates with weight one-third
definition.equal_question_estimand: average P or H within each question over only its available model-family mismatch records, then weight all 160 questions equally
definition.per_model_unit: one unique question within a hosted-model family; a family has at most one record for each question
definition.record_unit: one frozen (question_id, hosted_model) record whose selected and traced IDs resolve to distinct canonical passage PIDs
definition.sign_disagreement: the nonzero P gap and nonzero H gap have opposite signs

inputs.container_policy: bind exact scientific member bytes, not the outer ZIP

interpretation: Equal-question and equal-family weighting both reproduce 14 of 30 sign disagreements. Every family separately shows disagreements, with 15 for Claude, 9 for GPT, and 11 for Gemini; on common support the counts are 12, 9, and 12. The pooled result is therefore not an artifact of one family or of repeated-question row weights, although the exact count is family-dependent and ties are retained explicitly.
uncertainty_boundary: The 30 pair-cutoff comparisons are the complete fixed grid; they are not 30 sampled independent trials, so a binomial interval for the reversal count would be inapplicable. The separate frozen question-cluster report supplies dependence-aware intervals for the headline preservation-gap magnitude.
